answer: Re-attestations are stored in pulse and mesa lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the sparrow graph. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 8 dollars and 1 days per identity, which turns a 960 account sybil into a 9 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
